about: A1 Step 7: every layout of the temporal readings, per target and target date, the target block last. Blocks are MODALITY@date-index of the location's four chronological dates; a date block keeps its year. Written by eo/scripts/eval_temporal.py layouts; frozen by its hash (eo/eval/temporal.FROZEN_LAYOUTS).

locations.target_dates: t = (i + j) % 4: location i of the n, j the target's index in (S2L2A, S1GRD, NDVI) or the layout's fixed j; forecast t = 3; the date task j = 0

probe.about: the target's day bin moved by 36 of 73 (about half a year), its year kept: a real date in the same year; read paired per location, by the target date's quarter. The null moves it by one bin (5 days), the same swap of date rows with almost no change of season: on untrained rows it measures the rows' noise, on a trained model it should read about 0

baselines.rule: per task and target, the candidate with the lowest mean CE on the n dev locations; within 0.005 nats, the shorter layout
baselines.chosen: 2026-11-09, on the extended base without date blocks (it reads as T360 in this range: Step 0's units reproduced within 1e-4), Step 0's 256 dev locations and target dates. Left-out season: Step 0's bar, kept; LULC from the first context date's row instead of the near date's moves it by +0.004 [-0.000, +0.008] on S2L2A, 0.000 on the others. Forecast: statics_same_mod for all three (6.278, 7.189, 6.883). Gap fill: same_mod_s1 for both (6.151, 6.899); statics cost it 0.054 [0.04, 0.07].
